description: MySQL is the dialect that differs in more than spelling. A backslash is itself an escape character inside a MySQL string literal, so the ESCAPE clause carries a doubled one; and MySQL has no NULLS LAST, which 004-orderby covers. Booleans bind as 1 and 0, nothing is cast, and the argument list is unaffected by any of it.

cases.name: the ESCAPE clause carries a doubled backslash
the bound pattern is a parameter, so it escapes exactly as elsewhere
a boolean binds as an integer
a uuid is not cast, only lowercased in the argument
duration uses TIMESTAMPDIFF but still binds seconds
precedence and parenthesization are dialect-independent
cases.input: state = "shared" OR active = true AND words > 8
